name: fails with the client’s own reason when it lands on its login page

error.name: Error
error.message: The Riot Client opened on its login page instead of signing in (the client refused the saved sign-in (401 invalid_grant)), so VALORANT was not started. Sign in there with “Stay signed in” ticked and press Play; One Launch saves the sign-in at the next switch.

error.name: Error
error.message: The Riot Client opened on its login page instead of signing in (no saved sign-in), so VALORANT was not started. Sign in there with “Stay signed in” ticked and press Play; One Launch saves the sign-in at the next switch.
